new_senses.gloss: (mit l-) Gefallen an etw. finden, etw. mögen;
new_senses.rationale: The king likes the duck and seeks to capture it alive, excluding a fatal blow. The l- phrase names the duck as stimulus; -le indexes the experiencer/actor. One attestation. Stem I is a provisional filing consistent with the glossary’s Arabic extended loan stʔhl; Infectum is not attested and is left ?.
